title: Great practice
content:
I visited the practice on 27 January 2023 to have annual asthma review. The nurse spent good time to explain to me the guidlines and was patient enough to listen to other conerns were not related to the visit. She counsulted her manager and provided me with advice consider my personal circumistances.  Shw made me feel i am human. She made me respect het practice. 
Thanks to her and to the manager who was able to listen to her and respected her judment..
Over all the practice staff are friendly and able to accomdate patients needs ifbthey are able to .
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
